# polymarket-sports-mcp
> Tools and research for copying profitable Polymarket sports specialists onto Polymarket US, with every bet approved by a human. All data files below are generated by the copy pipeline (v4, rankings rebuilt from fresh data on 2026-11-12). No secrets are stored here.

- [docs/STRATEGY.md](docs/STRATEGY.md): the full method. Data endpoints, global→US slug mapping (aec/asc/tsc, UTC date fix, BUY_SHORT = 1 − price), selection tiers, credibility score, manual overrides, the rate-limit-safe weekly refresh, **flat ~$10 stakes**, resting-order execution, fee formula, and the HomeRunHazard NBA-spread rule (copy only his biggest spread at ≥ 1.2× usual size, even when he holds both sides; never mirror his full two-sided book).
- [docs/BACKTEST.md](docs/BACKTEST.md): condensed walk-forward results, plus the 2026-10-03 to 2026-11-11 HomeRunHazard NBA spread copy study.
- [docs/TRADE_LOG.md](docs/TRADE_LOG.md): every real pipeline bet placed so far, with price, shares, fee, wallet copied, and result.
- [data/rankings.json](data/rankings.json): every wallet × league × bet-type segment (1,382 segments, 2026-11-12) with settled bets, own ROI, shrunk credibility score, sizing-skill stats, status (keep/watch/drop), manual-trial flags, and field definitions.
- [data/rankings_diff_2026-11-12.md](data/rankings_diff_2026-11-12.md): who was added, dropped or moved versus the 2026-11-08 rankings.
- [data/conditional_edges.md](data/conditional_edges.md) / [.json](data/conditional_edges.json): edge by bet-size bucket and price band per segment. The headline is coin-flip (40-60c) pickers; it also flags conditional specialists and tests the 40c price floor.
- [data/manual_overrides.json](data/manual_overrides.json): persistent manual tier overrides (ianf2026 and chongchong37 NBA spreads on manual-trial watch) and wallet-specific rules (HomeRunHazard).
- [data/specialists.json](data/specialists.json): wallets currently copied (keep/watch tiers) and their allowed segments.
- [data/suppressed.json](data/suppressed.json): wallets profiled and not copied, with the reason. Rechecked after 30 days.
